query: I have a 95‑year‑old female inpatient with AMI. Among female AMI admissions aged 90–100, what is the 75th‑percentile lab‑instability score in the first 48 hours? For ≥P75 patients, report in‑hospital mortality, mean LOS, and critical lab rates versus all inpatients 90–100.
final_sql: SELECT amicadmissions75percentile.p75, amicadmissionsmortality.mortality_count, amicadmissionsmortality.average_los, alladmissions.total_admissions, alladmissions.average_los FROM amicadmissions75percentile JOIN amicadmissionsmortality ON TRUE JOIN alladmissions ON TRUE;
